# netcup_server_interfaces (Data Source)

Network interfaces of a netcup server, including IPv4/IPv6 addresses and their reverse DNS entries (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_interfaces" "srv" {
  server_id = 296155
}

# All IPv4 addresses with their current reverse DNS.
output "ipv4_rdns" {
  value = {
    for ifc in data.netcup_server_interfaces.srv.interfaces :
    ifc.mac => [for a in ifc.ipv4_addresses : { ip = a.ip, rdns = a.rdns }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Server id to read interfaces for.

### Read-Only

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Interfaces of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `driver` (String) NIC driver.
- `ipv4_addresses` (Attributes List) IPv4 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--ipv4_addresses))
- `ipv6_addresses` (Attributes List) IPv6 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--ipv6_addresses))
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `speed_in_mbits` (Number) Link speed in MBit/s.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--ipv4_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.ipv4_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `rdns` (String) Reverse DNS hostname.


<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--ipv6_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.ipv6_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `link_local` (Boolean) Whether this is a link-local address.
- `network_prefix` (String) Network prefix.
- `rdns` (Map of String) Reverse DNS entries, keyed by full IPv6 address.
